whatToWatch.text: Bounce-back ball at home: Seattle's 2-1 and riding a one-game skid, laying 7 as the favorite. A loud Lumen crowd and a win here resets the whole vibe of this young season.

That defense is the headliner — 16.7 points allowed per game and 2.3 sacks a game, now pointed at a Chargers team coughing up 25.3 points per contest. With an over/under of just 42.5, this one could get strangled early and never let go.

Injury board is worth a refresh before kickoff: one Seahawk is out with four more questionable, including Zach Charbonnet, Ty Okada and Julian Love. L.A. has nobody ruled out, but Derwin James Jr. and Keaton Mitchell are question marks of their own.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle limps home from Washington carrying a rare loss, one built on a stalled running game and three turnovers that handed the Commanders 21 points — exactly the sloppiness Mike Macdonald's group has to scrub before the Chargers arrive. The secondary could get reinforcements: Julian Love, sidelined by a calf injury suffered in practice, drew a "day to day" tag from Macdonald after encouraging Monday work. How the offense reestablishes the run will shape everything else in this one.
